CustomField.description: Indicates documentation or payment evidence is still outstanding before this booking can progress. A formula rather than a stored checkbox so it cannot drift, and so it adds no DML to an already heavily-triggered object. Document_Checklist__c relates by Lookup, not Master-Detail, so a roll-up of rejected checklist rows is not available; the signal comes instead from the fields the checklist automation writes back here - SalesOrderStatusAutomationHelper routes a rejection by setting Sub_Status__c back to the team that must act, and maintains the two fee statuses. If a stronger signal is needed, maintain a real checkbox inside DocumentChecklistController.sendToNextTeam - never from the console controller, since progression also happens from internal Lightning, from SalesOrderStatusApprovalTrigger and from batch jobs.
CustomField.formula: OR( ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "Pending with Sales"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "Pending With Sales."), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "Pending With Sales Operation"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "Pending with CM"), ISPICKVAL(Down_Payment_Status__c, "Partially Collected"), ISPICKVAL(Down_Payment_Status__c, "Partially Paid"), ISPICKVAL(ADM_Fees_and_Dari__c, "Partially Collected"), ISPICKVAL(ADM_Fees_and_Dari__c, "Partially Paid") )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Documentation or payment evidence is still outstanding on this booking.
CustomField.label: Further Documents Required
